name: Creality Hyper PLA (FDM, 1.75 mm)
description: Source document: Creality TDS v1.0, private vault copy, terms checked by thewriterben 2026-11-06. A specific filament, not a generic class, so a calibration measurement can attach to the spool that produced it. The vendor TDS v1.0 (cited) gives density 1.24 g/cm3, Tg 62 C and a 190-230 C nozzle range, all held with page citations in OpenPartsCore material/creality-hyper-pla. It gives no shrinkage figure and no dimensional tolerance, so shrinkage_pct_range and fdm_tolerance_mm are absent here: absent means unmeasured, never zero. They are discharged only by a calibration run in the ledger (ADR-0006, ADR-0013). Loaded in the K2 Plus CFS as RFID 01001 on 2026-11-06.
